svg.text: Each dot is the geometric mean over tasks of the candidate's median over the base's median, with a 90% bootstrap interval.
Green is clearly lower, red is clearly higher, and gray is within the noise.
Each cell is the change in the task's median. A cell is colored only when every repetition of the candidate was lower (green)
or higher (red) than every repetition of the base; hover a cell for the values.
